title: NIST WebBook: Acetone is C3H6O, molecular weight 58.0791 amu
summary: The NIST Chemistry WebBook lists Acetone as C3H6O, molecular weight 58.0791 amu, CAS 67-64-1.
body: The NIST Chemistry WebBook entry for Acetone, CAS Registry Number 67-64-1, lists molecular formula C3H6O and molecular weight 58.0791 amu. The same entry's monoisotopic molecular weight is 58.0418648 amu. The IUPAC InChI on the entry is InChI=1S/C3H6O/c1-3(2)4/h1-2H3. The molecular weight and the monoisotopic mass are two different fields. This card reports the catalog entry. It does not convert either field into a molar mass in grams, and it does not say that every real sample has that weight. It is also not the standard atomic weight in the NIST isotopic-composition file.
